title: Prove a complete funding obstruction for two-owner native multigraphs
body:
Proves a scoped obstruction for the #5456 funding model with arbitrary parallel two-owner classes and mixed Q/D fields. The uniform theorem gives at most `2c` Q fields for `c` four-support calls; a genuine three-coordinate spectral exception is compensated globally by the native-chain requirement. No finite search is used as a substitute for the uniform argument.

The actual retained source invoice selects 222 distinct early helper owners across 111 ports, leaves 217 untouched helpers per call, and bounds target rank by `5066c` against paid rank `5129c`. Under the stated independent-axis tariff hypotheses this excludes a positive funding margin for every `0 < s <= 1`. It does not establish a universal mechanism barrier, native implementation, or new κ.

Validation: normal and optimized registered replay and controls pass; 4,164 small spectral cases, 103 graph fixtures, exact constructed endpoints, and direct helper-owner accounting corroborate the proof. Missing and type-corrupt receipts are rejected. Committed-byte/source-history validation, explicit-input-ref export integrity, and read-only Git-free normal/optimized replays pass. Independent agent proof review is bound to head `1691a6024b60bdf28d7a2eed13cb32d78e2ea5b4` and reports no blockers; this is not proof-kernel or human certification.

Canonical investigation: https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/5501
